LanguageData.SS_LimitedAwarenessDesc: You know what your colonists know. Threats are discovered through surveillance systems or lookouts. Immersive and challenging.
LanguageData.SS_AreaOmniscienceDesc: You know more than your colonists. All local information is easily found, and events are omnisciently conveyed to you. The classic experience.
LanguageData.SS_BlowSignalHornDesc: Blow the signal horn to alert the entire colony to danger.
LanguageData.SS_HostileSpottedDesc: {0} has reported spotting a hostile ({1}) over the radio.
LanguageData.SS_AccessFeedsRemoteDesc: Connect to a local surveillance router to view camera feeds remotely.
LanguageData.SS_NoSurveillanceRouter: No operational surveillance router found on the network.
LanguageData.SS_DeviceNotLinked: This device has not been linked to a router. Select this colonist and right-click a router to link it.
LanguageData.SS_LinkedRouterOffline: The linked surveillance router is offline.
LanguageData.SS_AbortMonitoringDesc: Stop monitoring the surveillance feeds through the linked router.
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBar: Hide colonist bar in authentic mode
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBarDesc: While limited awareness is active in authentic mode, hide the colonist bar and its toggle button in the play settings.
LanguageData.SS_LinkAlarmBuildingDesc: Link this alarm trigger to electric lights, power switches, or colony loudspeakers.
LanguageData.SS_RadarOffline: Colony radar is unpowered or missing. Minimap offline.
LanguageData.SS_FriendlyScoutsDialogIntro: A diplomatic scout from {0} named {1} has arrived to verify relations and reports of colony conduct.
LanguageData.SS_ProvideTruth: Provide truth on colony actions (+10 goodwill, apply debts)
LanguageData.SS_LieToScouts: Conceal wrongdoing and lie ({0} success chance)
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsIgnored: Diplomatic scouts from {0} were ignored and reported negative conduct.
LanguageData.SS_EnemyScoutsFinished: Enemy scouts from {0} have finished reconnaissance and escaped with intelligence.
LanguageData.SS_LetterFriendlyScoutsText: A scouting party from {0} has arrived to check on colony conduct and relations. A negotiator can provide them with intelligence.
LanguageData.SS_LetterEnemyScoutsText: Scouts from {0} have arrived at the edge of your settlement to observe your colony's prosperity and potential unwanted activity. They will observe for a while then leave. They can be intercepted, but be warned that this can cause retaliation.
LanguageData.SS_LetterRetaliationText: After their scouting party did not return, {0} has sent another larger scouting party determined to discern the ongoings of this settlement.
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsTruthProvided: Provided intelligence to diplomatic scouts from {0}.
LanguageData.SS_ScoutsLieCaught: Diplomatic scouts from {0} discovered your deception.
